replacement.title: Microsoft Learn: Get started with Microsoft data analytics
replacement.evidence: Microsoft Learn FAQ: 'Microsoft Learn training is free and available to anyone'. Path: 4 modules (analytics process from data to insight, Power BI, end-to-end analytics in Fabric, Copilot in Power BI); no prerequisites.
replacement.why: Introductory path on what data analytics is, the analytics process and building first reports — the same goal as IBM's Introduction to Data Analytics.
replacement.gap: Microsoft-tool focused (Power BI, Fabric) where IBM's course is vendor-neutral; Microsoft labels it intermediate; no module on data-analyst careers. Some exercises need an Azure subscription (sandboxes retired).
